item.title: 2026 Taiwan Resume Guide: Format, ATS Screening Survival, and AI Tools
item.description: In 2026, 85% of Taiwan top-100 companies use AI screening (ATS). HR spends only 6-10 seconds per resume, but passing ATS is the prerequisite. This guide covers Taiwan resume format, ATS-friendly design, and AI tools (Cake/JobScan/104).
item.content:encoded:
In Taiwan’s job market, HR only spends an average of 6-10 seconds scanning a resume. But the more important thing is whether your resume can get in front of HR. The new reality for job hunting in 2025-2026 is: More than 85% of Taiwan's top 100 companies have introduced AI-assisted resume screening (ATS). Going through the ATS first and then being seen by HR is a two-stage battlefield for job hunting in 2026. This article tells you how to write a Taiwan resume in 2026 from the dual perspectives of ATS and HR.

2026 The double gates of Taiwan’s resume: ATS + HR

In the past, when writing a resume, you only had to take care of the HR reading experience. In 2026, you must first go through the ATS (Applicant Tracking System):

  • ATS stage: The AI system parses your resume text, compares it with the job description (JD), and calculates the matching score
  • HR stage: Human HR determines "whether it is worth arranging an interview" within 6-10 seconds

The design focuses of these two stages are different - ATS cares about "keyword density and functional relevance", while HR cares about "result specificity and first impression". If you do these two things at the same time, you will have a chance to interview.

ATS friendly design: keywords, structure, format

In 2026, Taiwan's ATS has evolved to not only "keyword matching", but also to analyze "the logical correlation between the hidden pain points of the job description (JD) and your experience." But the basic skills are still key:

Keyword optimization strategy

  1. Read JD word by word: Copy the job description to a text file and circle all nouns and verbs (skills, tools, industry words)
  2. Written as the original words: When JD writes "Python", use Python, and do not write "Programming"; when JP writes "Agile Development," use Python, and do not write "Agile" (unless JD also uses Agile)
  3. Moderate repetition: Important keywords appear once in "skills", "work experience" and "autobiography", but do not pile them up
  4. Avoid the abbreviation trap: "Human Resources" and "HR", "Business" and "Sales" must be written all once, because ATS may not necessarily know the corresponding relationship.

ATS friendly format

  • PDF: Most ATS already support PDF parsing, but complex layouts (2 columns, text boxes, nested tables) will fail to parse. Single columns and simple tables are recommended.
  • Font: Use standard fonts (Noto Sans CJK, Siyuan Hei, Arial, Calibri) and avoid custom fonts
  • File name: Name-Professional Title-2026.pdf (for example Wang Xiaoming-Marketing Plan-2026.pdf), do not use Resume-final-final.pdf
  • Don’t use pictures: Make the entire resume into a picture (JPG/PNG) = ATS cannot parse it at all = Direct elimination with 0 points

Basic format of Taiwan resume

Different from the European and American job market, Taiwanese resumes usually include:

  • Photo: Taiwanese companies generally attach great importance to first impressions, and it is normal to attach a formal headshot to a resume (European and American job markets usually do not include photos to avoid discrimination)
  • Basic information: name, date of birth, contact information, current place of residence
  • Education: Starting from the highest degree, going down, mainly university or above
  • Work experience: Arranged in reverse chronological order, with the most recent job first
  • Skills: software skills, language skills, certificates
  • Autobiography: Brief self-introduction and motivation for job search (100-200 words)

When submitting on platforms such as 104, 1111, Cake, Yourator, etc., the system will automatically help you typeset to the platform specifications. For customized delivery, it is recommended to use PDF, A4 paper, and a single page as a principle - most HRs do not have the patience to turn to the second page (except those with more than 5 years of experience).

Five key points that HR cares about most

1. Quantitative results of work experience

"Responsible for social media management" sounds vague. But "during his tenure, he grew the number of Instagram fans from 5,000 to 125,000, with a growth rate of 150%, an average monthly interaction rate increased by 45%, and a +30% increase in store visits." The value was immediately demonstrated.

What HR wants to see are specific numbers: growth percentage, number of projects completed, cost savings, team size led, number of users affected. Achievements without numbers = Achievements that didn’t happen (from an HR perspective).

2. Match between skills and job openings

Read the JD carefully to find 3-5 skills that the company specifically emphasizes, and make sure these abilities are clearly listed on the resume. If the job opening requires "Python and SQL", don't just say "familiar with programming" - this will be eliminated at the ATS stage.

3. Cleanliness of layout

Uniform font type, comfortable line spacing, and consistent margins—these details directly affect HR’s judgment of your professionalism. It is recommended to use Google Docs, Word templates or professional online resume tools (recommended below) to ensure a stable format.

4. Don’t write your autobiography like a running account.

"My name is Wang Xiaoming. I was born in Taipei. My parents are very supportive of me..." This type of autobiography is not helpful to HR at all. The autobiography should answer: "Why am I suitable for this position? What unique value do I have?" Control it within 100-200 words, and fine-tune the content for each position.

5. Customization is important

Don’t send the same resume to 10 job openings. Adjust your autobiography and skills ranking based on JD to let HR see that you have indeed carefully studied this position - this not only improves the chances of admission, but also shows basic respect for the company.

Must-use AI resume tools in 2026

The new generation of AI tools makes "customizing each resume" from tedious to feasible:

Tools Main Features Cost
Cake resume health diagnosis AI finds resume weaknesses + provides rewriting suggestions + ATS simulation Free
104 resume health check 104 built-in, optimized for Taiwan’s job market 104 free for members
JobScan Compare resume with JD, give matching score + missing keywords Free limit
Resume Worded LinkedIn profile + resume double scoring Partially free
ChatGPT/Claude Quantitative results rewriting, autobiography polishing, English translation Free version available

⚠️ Limitations of AI tools: AI can help you optimize wording, fill in keywords, and find logical loopholes, but cannot help you make up for experiences you have never done. Instead of letting AI "beautify" things you haven't done, it's better to honestly write about what you have done + use AI to write it beautifully.

LinkedIn Profile: The hidden ticket to senior positions

In 2026, 60-70% of Taiwan's mid-to-high-level positions (annual salary of more than 1 million) will be filled through LinkedIn / headhunting channels. In addition to the resume, a complete LinkedIn profile is a must:

  • Avatar: Same as resume, do not use travel photos
  • Title bar: professional title + field keyword (such as "Senior Marketing Manager | B2B SaaS | Data-driven marketing")
  • Experience description: Align with resume, but can be more detailed
  • Skills Endorsement: Invite colleagues to endorse each other, and more than 3 key skill endorsements can be entered into the headhunting search results
  • Recommendations: 2-3 paragraphs of recommendations written by past supervisors or customers, greatly improving credibility

Common fatal errors

Typos and inconsistent formatting

The most basic but most common mistake. If a resume contains typos, HR will directly put it on the list of people who will not consider it. Checklist: Mixing of traditional and simplified characters, inconsistent full-width/half-width symbols, wrong company name, and punctuation mark placement. It is recommended to read it 3 times, or ask a friend to check it, or use Word/Google Docs to check spelling.

Autobiography is too long or lengthy

HR only spends an average of 30 seconds reading an autobiography, and articles longer than 500 words will make them give up. Condensate the key points and express them in short sentences. You don’t need to tell your entire life story, just describe “your professional background” and “why you applied for this position.”

Salary expectations are written improperly

If you write too specific ("monthly salary 50,000"), you will easily be screened out; if you write too low, you will be considered unprofessional. It is recommended to write "negotiable" or "depending on the company's salary structure" and discuss it during the interview. If you must write it, give it a range ("45,000-55,000") instead of a single number.

Attached are irrelevant experiences.

Applying for a marketing manager job but giving a lengthy account of your experience working in a convenience store in high school will dilute your professional image. Prioritize the most relevant work experience, and briefly mention or omit old accounts. The space of one page of resume is precious, so leave it to the content that is most convincing to HR.

The photo is not professional

Selfies, travel photos, and pet photos are all prohibited. It is recommended to spend NT$ 500-1,000 to find a professional ID photo studio to take a formal headshot, which can be used for 5-10 years.

Differences in resumes in different industries

Technology Industry: GitHub account, personal portfolio, and open source contribution records are almost necessary. Rather than writing, companies value technical strength and recent projects.

Marketing Industry: Data and cases are king. State the size of the advertising budget you have operated, the conversion rate improvement, and the effectiveness of the strategy. Side projects (personally run IG/blog/en/newsletter) can get extra points.

Design Industry: Portfolio link is very important and should be placed in the most prominent position on your resume. The work speaks, the text is secondary. Behance / Dribbble / personal website all highlight design capabilities more than Cake.

Financial Industry: Priority will be given to relevant certificates (CFA, special examination, three financial certificates), academic qualifications and internship experience are also valued. Chinese and foreign businessmen value LinkedIn integrity.

Job transfer scenario (Jumping from industry A to industry B): The resume should emphasize "transferable skills" - what abilities learned in industry A can be directly used in industry B. For example, business to product managers emphasize the common capabilities of both industries such as "user insights", "cross-department collaboration" and "data analysis".

Resume creation tool

If you are not good at typesetting or want to quickly produce a beautiful PDF resume, you can use online tools. The resume tool provided by TWTools has a variety of built-in templates commonly used in Taiwan's job market, supports real-time editing, one-click PDF export, ensures uniform format, and passes ATS-friendly design inspection.

Finally, remember one thing: the resume is to screen for the interview, and the interview is the stage where you really show yourself. Spending 2-3 hours writing your resume is equivalent to getting a stepping stone - compared to the time investment of follow-up interviews + trial work + onboarding, this is the job search investment with the highest ROI.

item.title: 2026 Taiwan Public Holidays Complete Guide: 9 Long Weekends & Optimal Leave Strategy
item.description: 2026 Taiwan has 9 long weekends, 11 public holidays, 120 days off, and zero make-up workdays. This guide covers the 5 newly added holidays, 9-day Lunar New Year, and the optimal "request 4 days, get 16 days" leave strategy.
item.content:encoded:
Why can some people use a small amount of leave to create extremely long consecutive vacations, while others have their vacations broken up every time? The secret lies in planning in advance + mastering the two new systems in 2026: No make-up days throughout the year (the make-up system will be abolished from the second half of 2025) + Five new national holidays (Labor Day/Confucius’ Birthday/Taiwan Liberation Day/Constitution Day/New Year’s Eve). This article compiles the complete 2026 calendar + leave guide, and teaches you how to create the longest vacation with the least special leave.

Two new systems for 2026 Taiwan calendar

1. Cancel the make-up system (from the second half of 2025)

In the past, when national holidays fell on Saturdays or Sundays, the central government would announce "compensatory work days" (working on Saturdays would make up for a weekday). Starting from the second half of 2025, only make-up days will be provided but no make-up days - that is to say, there will be no make-up days in 2026. Good news for office workers: There will no longer be the weird situation of "having to work a make-up day on Saturday just to have four consecutive days off".

2. Added 5 new national holidays (the "Regulations on the Implementation of Memorial Days and Holidays" came into effect on 2025-05-28)

In the past, Labor Day, the abolished Taiwan Liberation Day and other holidays that were only reserved for workers for many years, will all return to national holidays in 2025 after the Legislative Yuan amended the law**:

Added national holiday Date Applicable objects
Little New Year's Eve Lunar Calendar 12/29 Nationwide (including civil servants and students)
Labor Day 5/1 The first nationwide unified holiday (in the past only laborers)
Confucius’ Birthday Anniversary 9/28 Nationwide
Taiwan Liberation Day 10/25 Nationwide
Constitution Anniversary 12/25 Nationwide

The biggest change: Labor Day on May 1 has changed from "labor only" to a nationwide holiday. Civil servants, faculty, and students will all have this day from 2026 (police, fire fighters, and military personnel may be transferred due to shifts).

Complete list of national holidays in 2026

National holidays in Taiwan are divided into two categories: fixed dates and lunar calendar changing dates. The following is the complete list in 2026 (the 115th year of the Republic of China), with a total of 9 Dalian holidays / 11 national holidays / 120 days of holidays throughout the year:

Continuous name Date Number of days Remarks
New Year's Day 1/1 (Thursday) ~ 1/4 (Sunday) 4 days including weekends
228 Memorial Day 2/27 (Friday) ~ 3/1 (Sunday) 3 days 2/28 (Saturday) + compensatory leave
Spring Festival 9 days 2/14 (Saturday) ~ 2/22 (Sunday) 9 days The longest in the year, New Year’s Eve 2/15 + New Year’s Eve 2/16 + Spring Festival 2/17-2/19 + Compensatory leave
Children + Tomb Sweeping Day 4/3 (Friday) ~ 4/6 (Monday) 4 days Children's Day 4/4 + Tomb Sweeping Day 4/5 Compensatory leave
Labor Day 5/1 (Friday)~ 5/3 (Sunday) 3 days The first unified holiday in the country
Dragon Boat Festival 6/19 (Friday) ~ 6/21 (Sunday) 3 days Lunar calendar 5/5
Teacher's Day + Mid-Autumn Festival 9/25 (Friday) ~ 9/28 (Monday) 4 days Mid-Autumn Festival 9/25 + Teacher's Day 9/28 + consecutive holidays
National Day 10/9 (Friday) ~ 10/10 (Saturday) 2 days 10/9 compensatory leave
Constitution Anniversary 12/25 (Friday) ~ 12/27 (Sunday) 3 days including weekends

⚠️ The complete official version shall be subject to the announcement of the General Office of Personnel and Administration of the Executive Yuan. 10/25 Taiwan’s Liberation Day falls on Sunday (an independent holiday), which does not form a consecutive holiday but is still a holiday.

Strategy for asking for consecutive holidays: Use the least special leave to create the longest holiday

The strongest combination: Spring Festival + 228, 4 consecutive days off, 16 days of fun

If you want to extend the Spring Festival holiday, you can combine the Spring Festival (2/14-2/22) and the 228 consecutive holidays (2/27-3/1) into a 16-day super long holiday (2/14 ~ 3/1) by taking 4 days of special leave from 2/23 (Monday) to 2/26 (Thursday). Here are the highest ROI leave strategies for 2026.

Suggestions for leave:

  • Arrange travel bookings early: Air tickets and accommodation prices will increase by 30-50% during the Spring Festival, and 16-day itineraries need to be booked 6 months in advance.
  • Avoid Friday eve of 2/13: the largest number of people returning to their hometowns, so you can leave in the early morning of 2/14 instead

Spring Festival: 9 days of consecutive holidays

Official holiday: 2/14 (Saturday) ~ 2/22 (Sunday), a total of 9 days, naturally formed with the weekends before and after.

Leave Suggestions:

  • If you only want to take 1-2 more days off, please take 2/13 (Friday) and change it to 10 days (2/13-2/22)
  • It is not recommended to extend after 2/23, unless you follow the "Please 4 and Release 16" full strategy

Children + Tomb Sweeping Day: 4 consecutive days off

Children’s Day has a supplementary holiday of 4/4 (Saturday) and 4/3 (Friday), and Tomb-Sweeping Day has a supplementary holiday of 4/5 (Sunday) and 4/6 (Monday), naturally forming a four-day continuous holiday of 4/3-4/6.

Leave Suggestions:

  • Want to extend the length: please 4/2 (Thursday), change to 5 days (4/2-4/6)
  • Advanced: please 4/2 + 4/7 (Tue), change to 6 days

Labor Day: 3 consecutive days off (new system in 2026)

The first nationwide unified holiday (new law takes effect on 2025-05-28), 5/1 (Friday) ~ 5/3 (Sunday).

Leave Suggestions:

  • Want to extend the length: please 4/30 (Thursday), change to 4 days (4/30-5/3)
  • Advanced: please 4/30 + 5/4 (Monday) ~ 5/5 (Tue), change to 6 days

Dragon Boat Festival: 3 days of consecutive holidays

6/19 (Friday) ~ 6/21 (Sunday), lunar calendar 5/5.

Leave Suggestions:

  • Want to extend the length: please 6/18 (Thursday), change to 4 days
  • Advanced: Please visit 6/18 + 6/22 (Monday) ~ 6/23 (Tue), it will become 6 days

Teacher’s Day + Mid-Autumn Festival: 4 consecutive days off

9/25 (Friday) Mid-Autumn Festival + 9/28 (Monday) Teacher’s Day + Confucius’ Birthday, combined with the weekend to form a four-day holiday 9/25-9/28.

Leave Suggestions:

  • Want to extend the length: please 9/24 (Thursday), change to 5 days (9/24-9/28)
  • Advanced: Please visit 9/29 (Tue) ~ 9/30 (Wed), it will take 6-7 days

National Day: 2 days

Compensatory holiday on 10/9 (Friday) + National Day on 10/10 (Saturday).

Leave Suggestions:

  • If you want to extend the length: please 10/12 (Monday) ~ 10/13 (Tuesday), change to 5 days
  • Note that Taiwan’s Liberation Day falls on a Sunday on 10/25, so it does not form a consecutive holiday (it is a full day holiday but it is a weekday before and after)

Constitution Anniversary: ​​3 days

12/25 (Friday) ~ 12/27 (Sunday). Added as a national holiday in 2026, in the past, civil servants and students had to go to work on this day.

Leave Suggestions:

  • If you want to take consecutive holidays during the New Year: please take 12/29 (Tuesday) ~ 12/31 (Thursday), which will become 8 days (12/25 ~ 1/3) with New Year's Day

2026 Leave Application Guidelines

Number of days of leave desired Number of leaves requested Recommended time period
16 days of super long vacation Please take 4 days of special vacation 2/23-2/26 Spring Festival + 228
8 days of New Year's Eve leave Please take 3 days of special leave 12/29-12/31 Tandem Xingxian + New Year's Day
6-7 days Please take 2-3 days off Teachers’ Mid-Autumn Festival 9/29-9/30 / Around Dragon Boat Festival
5 days Please take 1-2 days off Erqing 4/2 / Labor Day 5/4-5/5
4 days 0-1 day special holiday Most consecutive holidays are naturally 3-4 days

Tips for asking for leave

Submit leave application early

Most companies require vacation requests to be submitted 2-4 weeks in advance. Competition for popular holidays is fierce:

  • Spring Festival Holiday: Submit in December at the latest (high outbreak of return to hometown)
  • Qingming Festival: Submit no later than February
  • Summer vacation: Submit no later than May

Submitting early not only has a higher success rate, but can also help the company make personnel adjustments.

Make the most of your work-from-home day (WFH)

If the company allows WFH:

  • Leave + WFH combination: Please take 4/2 (Thursday) but can WFH for half a day, so you can spend time with your family and keep working
  • Every other week WFH: If you cannot apply for consecutive leave, you can consider taking 1-2 days off + WFH on other dates

Avoid booking during peak hours

  • Spring Festival: Avoid the core period of 2/14-2/22, instead go to 2/23-2/27, which is also a holiday but with half the number of people.
  • Qingming Tomb Sweeping: If it is not necessary to sweep the tomb, use alternative dates such as 4/2-4/6
  • Summer vacation: There are fewer people in mid-July than in early July, and air tickets are 20-30% cheaper

Vacation allowance (if allowed by the company system)

Some companies allow employees to accumulate annual leave, for example at the end of the year:

  • Do not waste this year's vacation, accumulate it to the next year or flexible date
  • Properly plan a multi-year long-term vacation plan (for example, accumulate 2-3 years of vacation and go abroad for 1 month at a time)

Cross-border Spring Festival comparison: What is the standard of 9 days of consecutive holidays in Asia?

Although Taiwan’s nine-day holiday during the Spring Festival in 2026 feels very long, looking at other countries in Asia that celebrate the Spring Festival, the gap in holiday days is actually very large. The following is a comparison of holidays in various countries on the first day of the first lunar month (2/17) in 2026:

Country Statutory holiday days Main actual consecutive holiday windows Remarks
Vietnam 7-9 days 2/14-2/22 Government annual announcement, 2026 about 9 days including weekends
Taiwan 7 days (including compensatory leave) 2/14-2/22 (9 days) including New Year’s Eve + 5 working days + weekend compensatory leave
Korea 3 days 2/16-2/18 Lunar New Year’s Eve to the second day of the first lunar month
Malaysia 2 days 2/17-2/18 States may add additional holidays (such as Sarawak)

It can be seen that Taiwan and Vietnam are tied as the two countries with the longest Spring Festival holidays in Asia. This is related to the dual factors of "the emphasis on Chinese New Year culture" + "the 2025 law amendment to add 5 new national holidays". Although the Lunar New Year in South Korea is also called Seollal (설날), there are only three days off on New Year's Eve, the first day of the lunar month, and the second day of the lunar month. Instead, there are more days off on Chuseok (Chuseok). As a multi-religious country, Malaysia only observes two days of Chinese New Year (national consensus), but other religious festivals such as Hari Raya Aidilfitri, Deepavali, and Vesak Day also have public holidays to balance the cultures of various ethnic groups.

In comparison, Taiwan’s nine-day Spring Festival holiday is among the top in Asia. If you have overseas friends, don’t forget to tell them: this is also the most popular time to buy air tickets, and the time when Taiwan’s high-speed rail and national highway passenger transportation is under the greatest pressure. If you want to go abroad, you should book 3-4 months in advance. If you want to travel domestically, avoid the three days of 2/16-2/19. It is easier to go to the outer areas of 2/20-2/22.

Countdown tool

item.title: Complete PDF Guide 2026: Merge, Split, Compress, OCR, Sign, and Password Protection
item.description: A 2026 complete PDF guide covering merge, split, compress, OCR, signing, and password protection — all directly in your browser without software, with a privacy comparison of Adobe, Foxit, and TWTools.
item.content:encoded:
PDF has become a common format in modern offices. Whether it is contracts, invoices, reports, resumes, or copies of documents, PDF is the first choice. But PDF also brings common troubles: the file is too large, the pages are scattered, text needs to be extracted from scanned files, sensitive content needs to be password protected, and electronic signatures are required... It would be too troublesome if you have to install professional software or find specific tools every time. The good news is that in 2026 most PDF operations can be done directly in the browser, and local processing ensures privacy.

PDF merge: convert multiple files into one

Scenario: You need to submit a complete application document, including resume, recommendation letters, degree certificate, and language test transcript, a total of 5 PDF files. HR asked to merge into one file.

Common uses of merging

  • Combine multiple invoices into one monthly statement
  • Consolidate multiple report chapters into a complete report
  • Concentrate scattered contract documents into one file
  • Integrate meeting minutes, sign-in sheets, and agendas into meeting files
  • Job application kit (resume + letters of recommendation + certificates)

Merge steps

Use this site's "PDF Tool":

  1. Enter the merge function
  2. Drag and drop or select multiple PDFs (usually 10-50 files are supported)
  3. If the order is wrong, drag and adjust directly.
  4. Click "Merge" and wait a few seconds
  5. Download the merged PDF

Tips: Many tools will display thumbnail previews before merging, allowing you to finalize the order; some tools support "insert separator pages" (blank pages) to separate different chapters.

PDF Split: Extract the required pages

Scenario: You receive a 50-page contract, but only need pages 1-5 and 20-25 to archive. Rather than printing them one by one, I want to extract these parts directly from the PDF.

Common scenarios for segmentation

  • Extract relevant sections from multi-page reports
  • Split scanned files (for example, files containing multiple people need to be divided into files by person)
  • Extract specific content pages in PDF, remove cover, table of contents, and index
  • Split lengthy files by topic
  • Assign different parts to different people

Segmentation steps

  1. Upload PDF
  2. Select the split mode:
    • By page range: Enter 1-5, 20-25, etc., the system will automatically retrieve
    • Split every N pages: For example, a new file is generated every 10 pages
    • Split by bookmarks: PDFs with table of contents/bookmarks can be automatically split by chapters
  3. Preview results
  4. Download the split file

Advanced Tips: Some tools support the "Delete Pages" function, which allows you to specify which pages to delete and keep others (for example, delete pages 30-40, and other pages will be automatically merged into a new file).

PDF Compression: Reduce file size

Scenario: Your report is 25 MB, and the company email system limits 10 MB attachments; or you want to send it to a client but their network is slow.

Why is the PDF so big?

  • Embed high-resolution images: scanned files may contain high-resolution photos
  • Embedded Fonts: Some PDFs contain complete font files
  • Unoptimized design: PDFs exported from Word often contain a lot of redundant information
  • Version Control Information: Some editing tools store historical information in the PDF
  • Uncompressed Streaming: No zlib / DEFLATE compressed content

Expected compression effect

Depending on the original file content, the compression effect is usually:

  • Text-based PDF: 50-70% reduction (5 MB → 1.5-2.5 MB)
  • PDF with images: 30-50% reduction (image lossless compression)
  • Scan file: 60-80% reduction (scan file contains a lot of redundancy)

Compression steps

  1. Upload PDF
  2. Select compression level:
    • HIGH QUALITY: suitable for documents that need to be read clearly (contracts, formal reports)
    • Web page quality: Suitable for screen reading (blogs, online sharing)
    • Low Quality: Extremely compressed, for archiving reference only
  3. Click Compress and wait for processing
  4. Download the compressed PDF

Note: Compression does not change the page content, it just optimizes the file structure. Text is still searchable. If it is a scanned file that has been OCRed, the text layer will also be retained.

OCR text recognition: Make scanned files searchable

Scenario: You get a scanned contract PDF and want to copy a certain text from it/use Ctrl+F to search for keywords, but you find that the entire PDF is in "picture" status and you cannot select text. This time requires OCR (Optical Character Recognition, optical character recognition).

OCR recognizes the "image text" of the scanned file as "selectable text" and embeds it into the PDF text layer. After completion:

  • Can copy text to Word/translate
  • You can use Ctrl+F to search for keywords
  • Can be edited with Acrobat / Foxit
  • Can be indexed by search engines or file management tools

Notes on Chinese OCR

  • Accuracy: Modern OCR is about 95-99% accurate for printed Chinese, but handwriting still has challenges
  • Traditional and Simplified Recognition: Confirm that the tool supports "Traditional Chinese" (some international tools only run Simplified Chinese by default)
  • Zhishu Recognition: The Zhishu layout of traditional documents and newspapers requires tools to support vertical recognition.
  • Special symbols: Punctuation, chemical formulas, and mathematical symbols may be misjudged
  • Proofreading is still required after OCR: Important documents must be quickly reviewed after OCR.

OCR tool selection

  • Google Drive: Free, upload the PDF and right-click "Open with Google Docs"
  • Adobe Acrobat: the most accurate, requires payment (monthly fee NT$ 462)
  • TWTools PDF OCR: Free browser processing, supports Traditional Chinese
  • ABBYY FineReader: Professional grade, suitable for scenes that require extensive processing

PDF password protection and signature

Password protection

PDF supports two passwords:

  • Open password: The file cannot be opened without a password (to prevent the file from being peeked)
  • Permission password: Can be opened but cannot be printed/copied/edited (to prevent file theft)

Implementation steps: Select "Protect/Encrypt" in the tool, enter the password, select the permission type, and save. Password must be remembered - PDF does not have a "Forgot Password" button, and professional cracking tools can only be effective on weak passwords.

Electronic signature

In 2026, Taiwan has generally accepted PDF electronic signatures (although it is not equivalent to the legal effect of physical signatures). Three common types:

  1. Image signature: Take a photo of your handwritten signature, make it into a transparent PNG and embed it into the PDF
  2. Digital Signature (Digital Signature): A cryptographic signature encrypted with a certificate + private key, which has legal effect
  3. Third-party signing services: such as DocuSign, Adobe Sign, and Dropbox Sign, providing signing process records and timestamps

⚠️ Legal Effectiveness: Taiwan's "Electronic Signature Law" recognizes the validity of electronic signatures, but it must meet the three elements of "identity verification", "repudiation" and "data integrity". General image signatures are often regarded as "signs". What is truly legally binding is a digital signature signed with an IC card/natural person certificate issued by the Ministry of the Interior.

PDF/A long-term storage

PDF/A is the "long-term archive version" of PDF, designed to be fully displayable 10-50 years later. The file will embed all fonts, avoid external dependencies, and remove interactive elements (JavaScript / form actions).

When to use PDF/A:

  • Contracts, deeds, legal documents
  • Government documents, tax files -Academic papers, research reports
  • Any document that needs to be readable 5+ years later

Many PDF tools have a "Convert to PDF/A" option, usually PDF/A-1b (Basic) or PDF/A-2b (Enhanced) is sufficient.

Form filling

Interactive PDF forms (government applications, bank forms, school applications) can be filled directly in the PDF tool:

  • Acrobat / Foxit / preview program can directly click the field to enter text
  • Print → Sign → Rescan is an outdated workflow
  • After filling in, save a new file (suggested file name: Form name-Filler-Date.pdf) to avoid overwriting the blank template

Batch processing of large files (>100 MB)

When the PDF exceeds 100 MB (common in photo albums, long reports, batch scans), many online tools will freeze. Handling suggestions:

  1. Split first: Use the PDF split tool to cut into small files < 50 MB
  2. Batch Compression: Compress one by one until the size can be uploaded
  3. If you need to merge: Merge after finishing.
  4. Local software: Adobe Acrobat/Foxit is more stable than browsers in processing large files

Tool selection comparison: Adobe / Foxit / TWTools

Tools Monthly Fee Privacy Functional Completeness Applicable Scenarios
Adobe Acrobat Pro NT$ 462 Cloud processing (can be turned off) Five stars Heavy users / OCR + digital signature required
Foxit PDF Editor NT$ 290 Cloud / local switching Five stars Windows users / budget considerations
PDF Candy / SmallPDF Free limit Upload to server Samsung Occasional use
TWTools PDF tool Free Local processing (no uploading) Samsung Value privacy + do not want to install software
macOS Previewer Built-in Fully native 2 stars Basic operations for Mac users

Privacy and Security: Why Local Side Processing Matters

Privacy is a legitimate concern when using online PDF tools. The design of this site’s “PDF Tools” prioritizes your privacy:

Why processing on the browser side is important

  • No upload to server: Your PDF stays completely in the local browser and does not go through any server
  • No logging: Files are deleted immediately after the operation is completed, no backup or tracking
  • No Advertising Tracking: Your PDF content will not be analyzed for advertising purposes
  • Available offline: Even if the Internet is disconnected, the opened tools can still be used

Recommendations for handling sensitive files

If processing PDFs containing personal information, financial data, business secrets:

  1. Confirm that the tool performs local processing instead of uploading to the server (see the tool description / developer tools Network panel to confirm)
  2. Clear the browser cache after completing the operation (optional)
  3. It is recommended to use Incognito/Private Browsing on public computers
  4. Use local software (Adobe / Foxit / Preview) for highly sensitive files

FAQ

Q: Will the merged PDF pages be renumbered? A: Usually not. Page numbers are determined by the original PDF. If you need to renumber, you can use the "page number" function of the PDF editing tool.

**Q: Is compression reversible? Can the original quality be restored? ** A: No. PDF compression is one-way, and once compressed, the original size cannot be restored. It is recommended to keep a backup of the original file before compressing it.

Q: Will the PDF after OCR become larger? A: Yes. OCR Adding a text layer to the original layer will increase the file size by 5-15%, but it will become searchable.

Q: What should I do if I forget the password after setting an activation password? A: There is almost no way to save it. Professional cracking tools are only effective for weak passwords of 6-8 characters, and complex passwords are basically unsolvable - so passwords must be saved in a password manager (Bitwarden / 1Password / Apple Keychain).

Q: Are electronic signatures as legally valid as handwritten signatures? A: Digital signatures that meet the requirements of the Electronic Signature Law have the same effect. Simple image signatures are often regarded as indications. It is recommended to use certificate signature or third-party signing platform for important contracts.

By mastering these PDF skills, you can process documents more efficiently in your daily work without relying on complex software or technical knowledge - most needs can be solved by a browser and the right tools.

item.title: 2026 Image Compression Guide: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF & HEIC Formats Compared
item.description: 2026 update: AVIF reaches 93% global browser support, iPhone defaults to HEIC causing compatibility issues. This guide compares JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC formats with 2026 platform specs.
item.content:encoded:
In the internet age, images are everywhere – in social media posts, product presentations, resume illustrations, and website visuals. But the problems that come with it are: the files are too large, uploading is slow, storage is expensive, and the website loads slowly. How to reduce image files to the smallest size while maintaining visual quality? The key word in 2026 is the three-piece set of "Choose the right format + Use the right tools + Set the right resolution".

Comparison of five mainstream image formats (2026 update)

In the Internet environment of 2026, JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, and HEIC are the five image formats you will encounter, each with its own applicable scenarios.

JPEG format (most widely compatible)

JPEG (Joint Photographic Experts Group) uses lossy compression technology. It was introduced in 1992 and is still the "greatest common denominator" format.

  • Advantages: Smallest file size, high JPEG compression rate for the same photo; accurate color reproduction, supporting 16 million colors; 100% support for all devices, platforms, and software
  • Disadvantages: Transparent background (alpha channel) is not supported, and block-like distortion (compression artifacts) is prone to occur when the compression quality is low.
  • Applicable: photos of people, landscape photos, product pictures, blog illustrations, social media uploads

PNG format (transparent + lossless)

PNG (Portable Network Graphics) uses lossless compression, and no color information is lost during the compression process.

  • Advantages: Supports full transparency (alpha channel) + translucency, suitable for design drafts, illustrations, and screenshots; color lossless, best quality
  • Disadvantages: Relatively large file size, for photos with high color complexity, PNG may be 3-5 times larger than JPEG
  • Applicable: Logo, icons, buttons, screenshots, design materials that require transparent background

WebP format (the mainstay of modern web pages)

WebP was developed by Google and came out in 2010. In 2026, it will still be the most commonly used next-generation format for websites.

  • Advantages: With the same quality, the file size is 25-35% smaller than JPEG and 26-34% smaller than PNG; supports transparency + animation (can replace GIF); Global browser support is about 97%
  • Disadvantages: Some old software and old systems do not accept WebP (Word 2019, some functions of the old version of the social platform)
  • Applicable: website optimization, modern web applications, scenarios requiring extreme compression

AVIF format (2026 new mainstream)

AVIF (AV1 Image File Format) was launched by Alliance for Open Media in 2019 and is based on AV1 video codec technology.

  • Advantages: 20-30% smaller than WebP (at the same quality), supports HDR + wide color gamut (WCG), and is the only format that supports the color accuracy of next-gen display devices
  • Disadvantages: Global browser support is 93% (Safari 16.4+ is already supported, and the last piece will be added in 2023), but the encoding speed is slower than WebP, and older versions of IE / Chrome < 85 are not supported
  • Applicable: Photography websites that value HDR/wide color gamut, streaming platforms, websites whose brand vision values color accuracy

HEIC / HEIF format (iPhone default)

HEIC (High Efficiency Image Coding) is Apple's default format starting from iOS 11 (2017).

  • Advantages: File is 50% smaller than JPEG, supports transparency, supports Live Photo dynamic effects
  • Disadvantages: Windows, Android, Chrome, and Firefox are not natively supported and need to be converted to be used in non-Apple environments; the licensing fee prevents website platforms from using them
  • Applicable: Transfer within the Apple ecosystem (iPhone → Mac, iPhone → iPhone), not suitable for uploading to websites and transferring to Windows/Android friends
  • ⚠️ Common pitfalls: iPhone users often fail to upload pictures to local e-commerce, government websites, and Line OA backends in Taiwan because the HEIC is not accepted. Settings → Camera → Format → Switch to "Most Compatible (JPEG)" to avoid

When to use which format?

Image Type Recommended Format Reason
People, scenery, product photos (community upload) JPEG Platform compatibility 100%
Logo, icon, button (need to be transparent) PNG or WebP Transparent + clear lines
Website main visual (no transparency) AVIF + WebP fallback Minimal file + wide compatibility
Website main visual (needs to be transparent) WebP (main) + PNG (downgraded) Supports both transparency and compression
Screenshots, UI design draft PNG Lossless, retain clarity
Social media sharing JPEG Most widely compatible
Email Image JPEG Most widely compatible, small file size
iPhone photo backup HEIC (Apple internal) or JPEG (cross-platform) See usage

picture element downgrade solution (website development)

<picture>
  <source srcset="hero.avif" type="image/avif">
  <source srcset="hero.webp" type="image/webp">
  <img src="hero.jpg" alt="主視覺" loading="lazy">
</picture>

This pattern lets the browser automatically choose the best supported format: modern browsers that support AVIF receive AVIF, browsers without AVIF fall back to WebP, and older environments fall back to JPEG. This is the standard approach for mainstream websites in 2026.

How to choose compression quality

Compression quality is usually a 0-100 setting. The higher the number, the better the visual quality and the larger the file. The key is to balance quality and file size.

JPEG quality settings

  • 80-85: the sweet spot. Distortion is almost invisible to the eye, and file size is often only 10-20% of the original. Recommended for most scenarios
  • 90+: print-grade quality, but files are larger. Unless the use case is high-end commercial work, this is often overkill
  • 60-75: fast-loading web images. Compression artifacts may become visible, but it is still acceptable for many web uses
  • Below 60: not recommended. Distortion becomes obvious, especially blocky artifacts on faces

PNG lossless characteristics

PNG uses the deflate lossless algorithm and does not have a quality parameter. File size depends on image dimensions and color complexity. You can reduce file size by adjusting color depth, such as 8-bit 256 colors versus 24-bit 16 million colors.

WebP quality settings

WebP works similarly to JPEG: 75-80 is a practical recommended range, while 85+ is high quality but may produce files closer to the original size.

AVIF quality settings

AVIF performs especially well at lower quality settings. 60-65 can often match the visual quality of JPEG 80-85 while producing a smaller file. Photography-heavy sites can often test 50-60.

Resolution vs file size

Another key factor in image optimization is resolution. It is easy to overlook, but it often has a larger effect than the compression quality setting.

Recommended resolutions for common 2026 scenarios

  • Website hero image: 1,920 px wide is usually enough; even on large 4K screens, you rarely need more than 2,560 px
  • Social media open graph image: 1,200 x 630 px, the common size used by Facebook, X, and LINE
  • Avatar or icon: 400 x 400 px or 500 x 500 px
  • Thumbnail: 300 x 300 px is usually enough
  • High-resolution screens (2x / Retina): use srcset or the picture element to serve different sizes by device pixel ratio instead of sending 2x images to every user
  • Story / Reels: 1,080 x 1,920 px, vertical 9:16

Golden rule: resize the image for its actual use case first, then adjust compression quality. In most cases, reducing dimensions has a bigger impact than tweaking quality settings.

2026 mainstream social platform image sizes

Platform Post image OG / share image Story / Reels Profile image
Facebook 1,200 x 630 1,200 x 630 1,080 x 1,920 170 x 170
Instagram square 1,080 x 1,080 1,200 x 630 1,080 x 1,920 320 x 320
Instagram portrait 1,080 x 1,350 - - -
X(Twitter) 1,200 × 675 1,200 × 675 — 400 × 400
LINE post 1,200 x 1,200 - - 240 x 240
Threads 1,080 x 1,080 1,200 x 630 - 320 x 320
LinkedIn 1,200 x 627 1,200 x 627 - 400 x 400

Each platform will recompress images after upload. Compressing your image to quality 80-85 before uploading usually keeps the platform's final output acceptable.

Practical compression workflow

  1. Define the use case -> choose the right format: social media = JPEG, website = AVIF + WebP fallback, screenshot = PNG
  2. Resize the image -> scale it for the actual display context
  3. Choose compression quality -> JPEG 80-85, WebP 75-80, AVIF 60-65
  4. Compress with a tool -> TWTools Image Compression supports conversion among all five formats
  5. Process in batches -> drag and drop multiple images and process 20+ files at once

Recommended online compression tool

TWTools Image Compression was built for this workflow:

  • Supports conversion among JPEG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF, plus one-click HEIC to JPEG conversion
  • Local processing: all images are processed in your browser and are not uploaded to a server
  • Live preview: compare before and after compression
  • Batch processing: drag and drop multiple images at once
  • No installation required: open it in your browser and use it directly

Real compression test: one 4K landscape photo

Using a 3,840 x 2,160 landscape photo with an original JPEG size of 8.2 MB, these are practical results by format and quality:

Format Quality File size Visual quality by eye Best use
JPEG 100 9.6 MB Lossless-looking, larger than original Print
JPEG 85 1.3 MB No visible difference Web standard
JPEG 70 720 KB Differences visible on close inspection Thumbnails
WebP 80 950 KB No visible difference Website galleries
WebP 65 580 KB Close to JPEG 80 Mobile-first use
AVIF 60 420 KB No visible difference Mainstream 2026 recommendation
AVIF 45 280 KB Differences visible on close inspection Extreme mobile optimization
PNG-24 lossless 11.4 MB Lossless Not suitable for photos

Conclusion: AVIF 60 can match JPEG 85 visually while cutting file size by roughly two thirds. If 95% of your visitors use current versions of Chrome, Safari, Edge, or Firefox, AVIF with JPEG fallback is one of the best 2026 practices.

Common image optimization mistakes

These mistakes often weaken image optimization results:

  • Uploading original camera files directly to a website: camera originals are often 24-50 MB. Uploading them without processing can burn visitor bandwidth and make mobile pages feel broken
  • Over-compressing important images: compressing a client logo or product image to quality 50 can make it visibly blurry. Quality 85 plus resizing is usually better
  • Saving too many photos as PNG: photos such as landscapes and portraits belong in JPEG, WebP, or AVIF. PNG is useful when you need transparency, screenshots, or UI assets
  • Compressing the same JPEG repeatedly: each compression pass introduces new artifacts. Always compress from the original source file
  • iPhone uploads failing on Taiwan backends: default HEIC files may be rejected by local e-commerce, government, or LINE OA systems. Switch to Most Compatible (JPEG) when compatibility matters

How image formats affect SEO

Since 2024, Google PageSpeed Insights has strongly encouraged AVIF and WebP for improving LCP (Largest Contentful Paint), one of the Core Web Vitals metrics that affects search performance. In practice:

  • Switching a site from JPEG to AVIF can improve average LCP by 30-40%
  • Mobile users benefit the most from smaller image files because network speed is often more constrained
  • E-commerce sites with many product images can benefit heavily from format optimization, potentially affecting conversion rates by 5-10%

For daily work, blogs, e-commerce, social content, and website design, image compression is a core practical skill. By understanding the five major formats and using the right tools, you can solve most image optimization problems: faster page loads, lower storage use, quicker social uploads, and better long-term SEO performance.

item.title: Taiwan Uniform Invoice Lottery 2026: Schedule, Prize Tiers & Cloud Invoice Auto-Claim
item.description: Taiwan's unique uniform invoice lottery draws every two months with up to NT$10M prize. This guide explains the schedule, 9 prize tiers, claim channels (convenience stores, banks, credit unions), tax withholding, and cloud invoice auto-claim benefits. Note: post offices stopped invoice claims since 2018.
item.content:encoded:
The unified invoice is a unique tax system design in Taiwan. Through the "Invoice Match", a national activity, consumers are encouraged to request invoices from merchants, indirectly assisting the government in tax audits. The lottery is held every two months with a special prize of up to NT$10 million. However, many people are not familiar with the prize collection channels, the advantages of automatic remittance of cloud invoices, and the "3 months from the 6th of the next month" rule for the prize redemption period. This article clarifies it once and for all.

Why does Taiwan have invoice matching? Institutional origins

The unified invoice prize system began in 1951 and was designed by the Ministry of Finance at the time. The purpose was not a lottery but a tax audit. The principle is:

  • If a merchant does not issue an invoice, it is equivalent to underreporting business tax.
  • Consumers must ask for an invoice in order to claim the prize, so they will naturally "ask for an invoice"
  • Merchants are forced to issue invoices → the government captures the full turnover → the tax base expands

This design has been in operation for more than 70 years and is one of the most successful audit tools for Taiwan taxation. Until now, "Have you given an invoice?" is still the most common question consumers ask when facing small stores.

In recent years, due to the popularity of cloud invoices, the system has been expanded from paper to "vehicles" (mobile phone barcodes, Easy Cards, credit card binding, etc.), making invoice matching more convenient, and automatic remittances can be exempted from stamp tax.

Lottery draw schedule: 6 draws per year, on the 25th of odd months

The unified invoice is issued every two months, 6 issues in total in a year, and the lottery draw date is fixed on the 25th of every odd-numbered month**:

Period (invoice month) Draw date
January-February Invoice March 25
March-April Invoice May 25
May-June Invoice July 25
July-August Invoice September 25
September-October Invoice November 25
Invoice for November-December January 25th of the following year

The lottery numbers will be announced by the Ministry of Finance in the afternoon of the lottery day, and the prizes can be matched from that day on.

9 prize categories, up to 10 million

The unified invoice award structure is divided into 9 levels, with 8 codes being the basic alignment unit:

Prize Category Winning Conditions Bonus Probability of Winning (Single Ticket)
Special Prize All 8 numbers (1 group) 10 million yuan 1 / 100 million
Special Prize All 8 numbers (3 groups) 2 million yuan 3 / 100 million
Jackpot The last 8 numbers match (including 3 groups) 200,000 3 / 10 million
Second prize The last 7 numbers match 40,000 yuan 3 / 1 million
Third prize The last 6 numbers match 10,000 yuan 3 / 100,000
Fourth Prize Last 5 numbers match 4,000 yuan 3 / 10,000
Fifth Prize Last 4 numbers match 1,000 yuan 3 / 1,000
Sixth prize Last 3 numbers match 200 yuan 3 / 100
Six additional prizes The last 3 numbers match (another 3 groups) 200 yuan 3 / 100

⚠️ Special Prize and Special Prize Matching Rules: The lottery numbers have an independent 8-digit sequence. The last 8 digits of the invoice must completely match to win the prize. It is not a digit comparison.

Overall, the winning probability of any invoice is about 9.4% (mainly contributed by the six prizes and the additional six prizes), which means that about 1 out of every 10 invoices can win 200 yuan.

Prize redemption channel: The amount level determines where to collect it.

⚠️ Important update (many old articles have not been updated): The post office has stopped redeeming invoice bonuses since December 28, 2018. The awarding channels are currently integrated into supermarkets, banks, and credit unions.

3 awards and above Starting from 10,000 yuan Same as 4 award channels (credit union/bank) For major awards, it is recommended that banks handle it
Special Prize / Special Prize 2 million / 10 million First Bank, Changhua Bank (it is recommended to make a reservation by phone in advance) You must present your ID card to apply

Please note: The prize collection pipeline is not the IRS (many older articles incorrectly stated this). The IRS is responsible for "re-issuance of invoices and dispute adjudication" and is not responsible for cash redemption**.

Redemption period: 3 months from the 6th of the following month

This is the most misunderstood part. The prize collection period is not "6 months from the draw date", the correct rule is:

  • Starting date: The 6th of the next month** of the lottery month**
  • Deadline: 3 months after the start date (including the current day)

Example (lottery draw on January 25, 2026, invoice for November-December):

  • Starting date: February 6, 2026
  • Deadline: May 5, 2026 (within 3 months)
  • If there is a holiday that year, the deadline will be postponed to the next working day

After the deadline, ** overdue will be regarded as abandoned and no reissue will be given**. In each issue, lottery tickets expired because the holder forgot to claim them, and the annual total of nearly 10 million yuan in prizes was lost.

Paper prize matching vs cloud invoice: automatic remittance is a hidden advantage

Paper invoice award process

  1. Obtain the invoice and confirm that it is complete and not torn or altered**
  2. Compare the lottery numbers after the lottery draw
  3. The winner brings the invoice and ID card to the prize redemption channel
  4. For prizes above 4,000 yuan, a stamp tax of 4/1,000 will be deducted (for 4,000 yuan, 16 yuan will be deducted) + 20% income tax (for 4,000 yuan, 800 yuan will be deducted)
  5. Actual amount received: 4,000 - 16 - 800 = 3,184 yuan

Cloud invoice matching process (recommended)

  1. Set Mobile Barcode (Registration on the Ministry of Finance’s Electronic Invoice Integration Service Platform)
  2. Inform the store of "vehicle" when making a purchase, and the invoice will be returned to your home electronically.
  3. Automatically match the prize after the lottery is drawn, and automatically send an email/app notification if you win the prize
  4. For those who have bound a bank account: The bonus will be automatically transferred into your account
  5. No Stamp Duty Deduction (Cloud invoice has no paper copy, stamp tax is 16 yuan free) + 20% income tax is also deducted
  6. The cloud invoice of 4,000 yuan is actually credited to the account: 4,000 - 800 = 3,200 yuan

Hidden advantages of cloud invoicing

In addition to saving stamp duty, the period limit for cloud invoices is 5 issues (about 10 months), instead of the paper "3 months from the 6th of the next month". Winning prizes will not expire because of "forgetting to claim them". For those who often buy low-consumption invoices, the accumulated winnings in 5 periods can be remitted in one go, saving you the trouble of redeeming your prizes multiple times.

Steps to set mobile phone barcode (recommended for everyone):

  1. Go to [MoF Electronic Invoice Integration Service Platform] (https://www.einvoice.nat.gov.tw) (einvoice.nat.gov.tw) to apply for a mobile phone barcode
  2. Enter "Host Account Settings" to bind a bank account (any Taiwan bank account)
  3. After completing the purchase, please ask the store to scan the barcode on your mobile phone.
  4. Winning prizes will be automatically transferred to the bound account.

FAQ: Frequently Asked Questions about Invoice Verification

Q1: What does it mean when the words "No Winning Invoice" are written on the invoice?

Some merchants will print a non-winning mark when issuing "Free Unified Invoice" or "Electronic Computer Invoice". This type of invoice cannot be matched for prizes and is more common in small transaction areas such as vendors, self-service laundries, and parking lots. Generally, "cash register unified invoice" (those with the words "unified invoice" printed in blue, purple or white) can win prizes.

Q2: Can I redeem the prize if the invoice is blurred or damaged?

As long as the prize number digits are clearly legible and the invoice body is complete, the prize can still be redeemed. However, if any of the last 8 digits is so blurred that it cannot be recognized, it is recommended to apply for a photocopy of the invoice from the IRS for confirmation before proceeding accordingly. It is recommended that you take photos and save the invoice immediately after receiving the invoice as a backup.

Q3: How to match the invoice for credit card payment?

A unified invoice will still be issued for credit card swiping. If it is a paper invoice (such as a restaurant, mass merchandiser), the bill and invoice are separated, and the invoice must still be verified by itself. If you use Credit Card Transfer (some card-issuing banks have this service), the invoice will be directly electronic and will not be printed on paper. It will be automatically compared with the cloud invoice. It is recommended to check whether this function is available in the card-issuing bank's app.

Q4: Are there invoices for overseas online purchases (such as Amazon and Taobao)?

No. The unified invoice is a unique system in Taiwan and is not covered by overseas e-commerce companies. However, **overseas e-commerce companies will issue electronic invoices through Taiwan tax agents (such as Apple, Google, and Netflix subscriptions), and the rewards can be returned to your home through the vehicle.

Q5: What should I do if the merchant doesn’t give me an invoice?

According to the "Value-Added and Non-Value-Added Business Tax Law", merchants who refuse to issue invoices can report to the Ministry of Finance and the National Taxation Bureau. If the report is successful, there will be a bonus (5-20% of the tax evasion amount). Reporting channels: Dial 0800-000-321 (the service hotline of the National Taxation Bureau) or go to the Ministry of Finance Tax Portal to report online.

Conclusion: paper skills, cloud, etc.

The best strategy for unified invoice matching:

  1. Set mobile phone barcode: Use vehicles as much as possible for all purchases, save stamp duty + no need to run to redeem prizes + will not expire
  2. A few paper invoices: Prizes will be matched immediately after the lottery day. For amounts above 4,000 yuan, go to the bank/credit union for processing.
  3. Avoid expiration: Paper period is "3 months from the 6th of the next month", cloud period 5 is about 10 months
  4. Keep all invoices for at least one month: for financial and tax records, return and exchange vouchers

By mastering the correct channels and timetables for claiming prizes, the accumulated amount of prizes invoiced every year may be more than you think. View the Taiwan Lottery Matching Tool on this site, including integrated query of invoice winning numbers →

item.title: 2026 Currency Exchange Guide: 6 Channels, Fees, Airport & ATM Reality in Taiwan
item.description: Whether traveling overseas, shopping abroad, or paying with credit cards, knowing how to exchange currency well saves real money. This 2026 update covers six exchange channels with actual fees and exchange rates, plus the 1.5% foreign transaction fee logic and the DCC trap.
item.content:encoded:
When traveling abroad, studying overseas, or shopping online across borders, currency exchange is an unavoidable task. However, for the same exchange demand of US$1,000, if operated through different channels and at different times, the price difference may be NT$800 to NT$2,000**. The latest version of this article in 2026 takes stock of the actual costs of 6 types of currency exchange channels, from exchange rate types and fee structures to the calculation logic and DCC traps of 1.5% for overseas card swiping, helping you choose the right method for every currency exchange.

1. Understand exchange rate quotes: spot, cash, buy, sell

Open any bank's advertised exchange rate page and you will see four columns of numbers. Let us first distinguish these four words clearly, and all subsequent comparisons will be based on this basis.

Spot Rate (Spot Rate): used for transfers between foreign currency accounts, online foreign exchange settlement, and overseas credit card payments. No physical banknotes are delivered, banking operations are cheaper and the exchange rate is most favorable to customers.

Cash Rate (Cash Rate): used for cash buying and selling. Banks have to import, keep and count cash, which requires high operating costs and the exchange rate is worse than the spot.

Buying Rate (Buying Rate): The price at which the bank buys foreign currency from you - look at this column when you exchange foreign currency for Taiwan dollars.

Selling Rate (Selling Rate): The price at which the bank sells foreign currency to you - look at this column when you exchange Taiwan dollars for foreign currency.

In practice** spot rates are 0.5%–1.5%** better than cash rates** (depending on the currency). Taking the U.S. dollar as an example, during the observation period in the first half of 2026, the price difference between spot selling and cash selling was approximately NT$0.30/USD, and the difference in exchange for 1,000 US dollars was approximately NT$300. The price difference of Japanese yen is even more obvious, with a common price of NT$0.04/yen, and the difference is about NT$400 when exchanging 100,000 yen.

**Conclusion: If you can use immediate payment, you don’t need cash. ** However, you need to use banknotes at the tourist site, and eventually you have to exchange them for cash - at this time, you need to rely on the "choosing the right currency exchange channel" mentioned below to keep the cost down.

2. Comparison of actual costs of 6 types of currency exchange channels (latest in 2026)

Pipeline Exchange rate type Handling fee Recommendation Applicable scenarios
① Online foreign exchange settlement (Mega/Taiwan Bank) Spot 0 Yuan ★★★★★ Plan more than 2 weeks before going abroad
② Bank App Currency Exchange Spot 0 Yuan ★★★★★ Exchange to foreign currency account and keep for use
③ Bank counter Cash About 100 yuan/transaction ★★★ If you are in a hurry to get banknotes, large transactions must be confirmed in person
④ Foreign currency ATM (Taiwan dollar account debit) Cash card notice + inter-bank fee NT$5 Inter-bank NT$5 + bank preferential exchange rate ★★★★ Urgent need of small amounts of cash, 24h
⑤ Airport bank counter Cash Exchange NT$0 for foreign currency ★★★ Temporary needs on the day of departure
⑥ Overseas local ATM withdrawal Spot + overseas withdrawal fee 75–150 yuan/transaction + overseas local handling fee ★★★ Top up cash during the trip

① Online foreign exchange settlement (the most cost-effective legal channel)

Both Mega Bank and Bank of Taiwan provide 24-hour online foreign exchange settlement: log in to online banking and fill in the form → agree on the bank withdrawal branch → collect it at the branch (or pick it up at the airport) within 7 working days. Spot exchange rate + 0 handling fee + no need to queue, suitable for people who plan more than 2 weeks before going abroad. Major currencies such as the Japanese yen, US dollar, euro, and renminbi are all supported.

② Bank App Spot Currency Exchange

Many banks (Taishin, Yushan, Cathay Pacific, Wing Fung...) have launched 24-hour currency exchange in the app, which allows you to directly exchange from your Taiwan dollar account to the foreign currency account of your peers, with spot exchange rates and no handling fees**. The foreign currency exchanged can be left in the account and can be spent online, and you can go to the counter to collect cash before leaving the country.

③ Bank counter

Through traditional channels, the exchange rate of "cash sales" is unfavorable, and some banks charge a handling fee of less than 100 yuan/transaction. The advantage is that large amounts (over RMB 500,000) require double verification in person for greater peace of mind, and travel expenses or overseas remittances can be processed at the same time.

④ Foreign currency ATM (in Taiwan)

Direct debit from Taiwan dollar account to exchange foreign currency cash. The exchange rate is based on the banknotes of each bank (some banks have discounts), and the inter-bank handling fee is only NT$5. For example: When Yushan Bank withdraws money from a Taiwan dollar account, the exchange rate is cash, plus 5 cents for the U.S. dollar and 0.1 cents for the Japanese yen.

The calculation method for withdrawals from foreign currency account is different: Mega has a fixed 100 yuan per transaction, Taishin has changed to "the difference between the spot exchange rate and the cash exchange rate × 0.5" with a minimum of 100 yuan since 2025-06-06, and Yushan has a "foreign currency amount × exchange difference × 0.9" with a minimum of 100 yuan.

⑤ Airport bank counters and foreign currency cash exchange machines

Both Taoyuan Airport Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 have Taiwan Bank and Mega Bank counters open 24 hours a day. 0 handling fee for converting New Taiwan dollars to foreign currencies (policies of both companies), but the exchange rate of "cash sales" is slightly worse than that of urban banks (affected by 24h labor costs and the urgency of tourists).

Peach Machine will add a "foreign currency banknote exchange machine" (foreign currency banknote exchange machine) starting from 2024. There is no handling fee for banknote exchange. The exchange rate is based on the bank notice. It is a good emergency solution if you forget to change money before departure. But please note: the machine only accepts banknotes of specific denominations, and the change method varies from machine to machine.

⑥ Overseas local ATM withdrawal

Cash cards with the PLUS or Cirrus logo can be used to withdraw local currency at overseas ATMs. The exchange rate is close to the spot (converted by international organizations), but each transaction requires Taiwanese bank overseas withdrawal fee of 75-150 yuan + local ATM handling fee (Japanese 7-11 ATM about 220 yen / American bank about USD 3-5). It is cost-effective to withdraw large amounts (over NT$5,000), but it is least cost-effective to withdraw multiple small amounts.

3. Trial calculation of the cost of swiping cards overseas vs. exchanging cash

Many people are confused about whether they should swipe their cards or exchange cash when abroad. Let’s first look at the calculation formula for credit card swiping:

Total cost of overseas card swiping = foreign exchange exchange by international organizations (near the spot exchange rate) + overseas handling fee 1.5%

Banks in Taiwan of the three major international organizations, VISA, Mastercard and JCB, charge a uniform 1.5% (international organization 1% + 0.5% bank surcharge limit approved by the Financial Supervisory Commission), and American Express 2%. This 1.5% is included in the bill amount and is not an additional deduction.

Trial calculation: Buy 100,000 yen goods in Japan

  • Method A: First exchange 100,000 yen in cash online in Taiwan: Based on the spot exchange rate + 0 handling fee - assuming a conversion of 0.218, the cost is about NT$21,800
  • Method B: Overseas card swiping: Swipe the card at the spot exchange rate (also around 0.218) + 1.5% handling fee - the cost is about NT$22,127 (difference NT$327)
  • Method C: Airport Cash Counter: Sell in cash 0.221 + 0 handling fee - Cost approximately NT$22,100
  • Method D: Withdraw 100,000 yen from an overseas ATM: Spot 0.218 + Taiwan overseas withdrawal fee 100 yuan + Japanese ATM handling fee 220 yen (approximately NT$48) - cost approximately NT$21,948

Conclusion: Online foreign exchange settlement (Method A) is the cheapest, but when the cash exchanged on site is used up, Swiping a card overseas (Method B) is more cost-effective than exchanging cash at the airport (Method C). ATM withdrawal (method D) is reasonable as an emergency solution to replenish money during the trip, but it is not suitable for withdrawing the full amount at the beginning.

DCC Trap: The store asks you "Would you like to settle in Taiwan dollars or local currency?"

DCC (Dynamic Currency Conversion) is a service where foreign stores or ATMs actively ask whether to "display the amount in Taiwan dollars". Please always choose local currency: DCC uses the store's custom exchange rate, which is usually 3%-7% worse than the exchange rate of international organizations. Plus your overseas handling fee of 1.5% will still be charged, which is equivalent to a double markup.

The hidden definition of overseas consumption

"Overseas consumption" is not just about physically swiping your card abroad. Netflix, Spotify, Disney+, Apple One, Uber Eats, Foodpanda, ChatGPT Plus subscription, etc. are all overseas consumption, and each transaction will be charged a 1.5% handling fee. It is recommended to concentrate this type of subscription on a card with good overseas rewards (SinoPac, Taishin Richart, Far East Roca+, HSBC Cashback, etc.), and offset the 1.5% or even earn back.

4. Judgment of currency exchange timing

Large-amount currency exchange: batching is common sense

If you want to exchange foreign currency of more than NT$500,000, enter the market in 3-5 batches within 1-2 months to avoid the risk of single-point price fluctuations. The common currency amplitude during the year is 5%–10%, and it can be pulled close to the average in batches.

Look at the central bank’s announcement and interest rate spread trends

The Taiwan dollar against the U.S. dollar is mainly affected by the U.S. dollar index (DXY), Taiwan-U.S. interest rate differentials, and exporters’ U.S. dollar settlement needs. The Fed's interest rate cut/raise meeting week is highly volatile, so you can choose to observe the direction 2-3 days after the meeting before entering the market.

Set price alert

TWTools' [Exchange Rate Conversion Tool] (/forex/) displays real-time advertisements, sets a target price with the mobile notification function, and places an order when the target is met.

5. Currency exchange habits for popular tourist currencies

Japanese Yen (JPY): Fluctuates greatly, and online foreign exchange settlement is relatively stable in batches 2 weeks before departure. Most large stores and convenience stores in Japan accept credit cards, but small country stores, shrines, and vendors still often require cash**.

United States Dollar (USD): Some countries in Southeast Asia and Central and South America also accept US dollar cash. It is recommended to bring small denominations (USD 1, 5, 10) for easy change.

Hong Kong Dollar (HKD): In most places in Hong Kong, credit cards and electronic payments are the main payment methods. You only need to carry 1,000–2,000 HKD.

Korean Won (KRW): Card swiping is extremely popular in South Korea (night market vendors all accept T-money), and only 50,000-100,000 Korean won can be exchanged for tips and emergencies.

Euro (EUR) and British Pound (GBP): Easy to use, but cash is mainly in 5/10/20 denominations, avoid 100/200 banknotes (many stores do not accept them).

Renminbi (CNY): In China, WeChat and Alipay are the main payment methods. Cash is almost non-circulating, and a small amount of cash is sufficient for backup.

6. FAQ

**Q1: ​​Why is the spot exchange rate better than the cash exchange rate? ** Spot is a digital transfer between accounts. There is no physical banknote delivery, and the bank does not need to bear the costs of storage, transportation, counting, etc. The quoted price of cash cards includes cash handling costs, so it is 0.5%–1.5% worse than spot.

**Q2: Are the banknotes for online exchange settlement new or old? ** According to each bank's policy, most banks do not guarantee new or old banknotes, but will issue banknotes that are "fit for circulation" (without damage or stains). If you want to give a gift or exchange new banknotes, it is recommended to go to a branch to make a reservation at the counter.

**Q3: Are the foreign currency cash exchange machines at the airport reliable? ** The Peach Machine foreign currency cash exchange machine is set up by the bank. The exchange rate is reported according to the bank card. There is no handling fee for currency exchange. It is a good choice for 24-hour emergency relief. However, the machine only accepts specific denominations and may not be able to provide change. Please read the machine instructions before using it.

**Q4: Is it worth getting an overseas rewards credit card? ** If your monthly overseas card usage + overseas subscription total exceeds NT$5,000, you can completely offset the 1.5% handling fee by applying for an overseas card with a rebate of ≥ 3%, or even make money back. If the amount is less than this amount, the management cost will be high.

**Q5: If DCC has selected the local currency, will it still be charged a handling fee? ** 1.5% will still be charged because the handling fee is generated by the action of "cross-border credit card swiping" (1% for international organizations + 0.5% for banks). But you avoid the extra 3%–7% water exchange rate of DCC, and you still save money overall.

in conclusion

In 2026, Taiwan has more currency exchange options than in the past: Online foreign exchange settlement (Mega/Taiwan Bank, 0 handling fee + spot exchange rate) is the first choice, Foreign currency ATM is suitable for 24-hour emergency use of small amounts, Airport foreign currency cash exchange machine is an emergency solution on the day of departure, Overseas card swiping choose the right reward card to directly offset the 1.5% handling fee.

The deeper you understand currency exchange, the more you save on "handling fees" - a 10-day trip to Japan and 10 cross-border subscriptions a year can add up to several meals of ramen. Next time before going abroad, open TWTools' [Exchange Rate Conversion Tool] (/forex/), take a look at Taiwan's silver medal advertisement, and then decide which channel to take. These 5 minutes of homework are worth more than you think.

item.content:encoded:
Taiwan's lottery turnover exceeds 100 billion yuan every year, and it is a small-dollar entertainment habit for many people. However, many lottery fans actually don’t know who the issuer is, how different the odds of winning are for different lottery types, and how much tax will be deducted when claiming the prize. This article clarifies the gameplay, lottery time, and prize collection process of the three major lottery types at once, and updates them to the latest regulations in 2026.

Taiwan Lottery: Who issues it and where are the proceeds used?

Many people mistakenly believe that "Taiwan Lottery" is issued by banks in Taiwan. This is a common mistake. The correct structure is as follows:

  • Authorized Unit: Ministry of Finance
  • Issuing institution: China Trust and Commercial Bank (CTBC Bank, taken over since 2014)
  • Operating unit: Taiwan Lottery Co., Ltd. (subsidiary of China Trust)

This three-tier structure represents: After deducting bonuses and operating expenses from lottery sales revenue, the surplus must be transferred to the "Public Welfare Lottery Surplus Distribution Fund"** and distributed to:

  • Municipality, county and city government: used for social welfare expenditures (such as subsidies for low-income households, care for the elderly, and support for people with disabilities)
  • National Pension Fund: Supplement social security financial resources
  • National Health Insurance Reserve: Reduce the financial pressure on health insurance

In other words, even if you don’t win the lottery, part of the money will go back to social welfare. Understanding this meaning will help you to view lottery consumption in a healthy way and treat it as a small amount of entertainment and public welfare participation, rather than a shortcut to escape poverty.

Power Lottery: The lowest chance of jackpot and the highest accumulation

Super Lotto 638 is the most topical lottery among Taiwan lotteries because the jackpot prizes can be accumulated without an upper limit and once exceeded NT$3 billion.

Game rules

Weili Caicai Dual Zone System:

  • Area 1: Choose any 6** numbers from 01 to 38
  • Second Area: Choose any number from 01 to 08

Both areas need to match to win the jackpot. Each bet is $50.

Chance of winning

There are a total of 2,760,681 combinations of 6 out of 38 in the first area of ​​the PowerColor. Multiplied by 1 out of 8 in the second area, the total number of combinations is 22,085,448. The overall chance of winning any prize is about 11.78%.

Every Monday and Thursday night 20:30 (note: a common mistake is to write "21:30", the correct number is 20:30).

Grand Lotto: Jackpot Guaranteed 100 Million Yuan

The gameplay of Big Lotto is relatively intuitive. Although the jackpot is not as high as Power Lottery, it is guaranteed to start at at least 100 million yuan per issue, making it the first choice for many people to get started.

Every Tuesday and Friday evening 20:30.

Jincai 539: Little luck every day
